title: 日本ダービーの後に・遠い背中

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff… gasp…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine. I just… wasn't good enough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch up to Bourbon! I have to…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have to… work harder…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Zzz… zzz…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her strength exhausted, she collapses before me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush forward to lend her my shoulder to rest on. And as I do…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Her choice of words does not match the scenario we are in.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Considering the outcome of the race, she should have said she "lost."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is not a matter of whether she "caught up" to me or not. Should you not correct her?
choice_data_list: Catching up to you is what was important to her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This… does not compute.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I didn't mean cause you trouble…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh… There's no hope for me, is there?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm such a burden to you… And even when racing… I can't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I have to work even harder next time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Tell me… what race do you think Bourbon will run in next?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Tell me… what race do you think Bourbon will run in next?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I think you're right. Then, that means… I'm going too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm… going to do my best. And next time… I'll catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is the final race in the Triple Crown tour—a 3000-meter long-distance turf race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Rice Shower is a stayer, that means her chances of victory are the highest they've ever been!
